grid.expression: SELECT CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.CHAVENFE, CAB.CODTIPOPER, (SELECT DISTINCT DESCROPER FROM TGFTOP T WHERE T.CODTIPOPER = CAB.CODTIPOPER) AS DESCROPER, TRUNC(CAB.DTENTSAI) AS DTENTSAI, CAB.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, (SELECT (SUM(NVL(QTDNEG,0))) FROM TGFITE I WHERE I.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA) AS QTDSALDO, (SELECT (SUM(NVL(QTDNEG,0))) FROM TGFITE IT WHERE IT.NUNOTA IN (SELECT DISTINCT C.NUNOTA FROM TGFCAB C WHERE C.CODTIPOPER = 1202 AND C.CHAVENFEREF = CAB.CHAVENFE)) AS DEBITO, (CASE WHEN (SELECT (SUM(NVL(QTDNEG,0))) FROM TGFITE I WHERE I.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA) > (SELECT (SUM(NVL(QTDNEG,0))) FROM TGFITE IT WHERE IT.NUNOTA IN (SELECT DISTINCT C.NUNOTA FROM TGFCAB C WHERE C.CODTIPOPER = 1202 AND C.CHAVENFEREF = CAB.CHAVENFE)) THEN 'PENDENTE' WHEN (SELECT (SUM(NVL(QTDNEG,0))) FROM TGFITE I WHERE I.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA) = (SELECT (SUM(NVL(QTDNEG,0))) FROM TGFITE IT WHERE IT.NUNOTA IN (SELECT DISTINCT C.NUNOTA FROM TGFCAB C WHERE C.CODTIPOPER = 1202 AND C.CHAVENFEREF = CAB.CHAVENFE)) THEN 'COMPLETO' ELSE 'PENDENTE' END) TESTE FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC WHERE CAB.CODTIPOPER IN (1108,2208) AND (:P_CODPARC IS NULL OR CAB.CODPARC = :P_CODPARC) AND (:P_PERIODO IS NULL OR (TRUNC(CAB.DTENTSAI) >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND TRUNC(CAB.DTENTSAI) <= :P_PERIODO.FIN)) ORDER BY CAB.DTENTSAI, CAB.NUNOTA

grid.title: Nota Original
grid.expression: SELECT ITE.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, ITE.CODVOL, (CASE WHEN VOA.CODPROD IS NULL THEN ITE.QTDNEG WHEN VOA.DIVIDEMULTIPLICA = 'D' THEN ITE.QTDNEG * VOA.QUANTIDADE ELSE ITE.QTDNEG / VOA.QUANTIDADE END) AS QTDNEG FROM TGFITE ITE INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD LEFT JOIN TGFVOA VOA ON (VOA.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD AND VOA.CODVOL = ITE.CODVOL AND ((ITE.CONTROLE IS NULL AND VOA.CONTROLE = ' ') OR (ITE.CONTROLE IS NOT NULL AND ITE.CONTROLE = VOA.CONTROLE))) WHERE ITE.NUNOTA = :A_NUNOTA ORDER BY ITE.CODPROD

grid.title: Nota Retorno
grid.expression: SELECT ITE.NUNOTA, ITE.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, ITE.CODVOL, (CASE WHEN VOA.CODPROD IS NULL THEN ITE.QTDNEG WHEN VOA.DIVIDEMULTIPLICA = 'D' THEN ITE.QTDNEG * VOA.QUANTIDADE ELSE ITE.QTDNEG / VOA.QUANTIDADE END) AS QTDNEG FROM TGFITE ITE INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD LEFT JOIN TGFVOA VOA ON (VOA.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD AND VOA.CODVOL = ITE.CODVOL AND ((ITE.CONTROLE IS NULL AND VOA.CONTROLE = ' ') OR (ITE.CONTROLE IS NOT NULL AND ITE.CONTROLE = VOA.CONTROLE))) INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA WHERE CAB.CODTIPOPER IN (1202) AND ITE.NUNOTA IN (SELECT DISTINCT C.NUNOTA FROM TGFCAB C WHERE C.CODTIPOPER = 1202 AND C.CHAVENFEREF = (SELECT CHAVENFE FROM TGFCAB WHERE NUNOTA = :A_NUNOTA)) ORDER BY ITE.CODPROD
